confidence_notes: Holistic estimates for July 2026. Restaurant and lodging prices are moderately predictable; beer and especially wine prices are less certain because alcohol is relatively expensive in Malaysia. Cocktail and wine estimates use their typical local price relationship to beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on George Town's Malaysian tourist-city cost profile, with regional comparison to places such as Melaka and Ipoh: affordable local meals and guesthouses, but higher prices for alcohol and tourist-oriented lodging.
